exchanges: night shifts as a dispatcher are wrecking my sleep
That schedule is brutal on the body clock.
slept til noon and still feel like a zombie
Maybe some sunlight and water will help shake it off.
my boyfriend aurelio made me soup at least
That's a sweet thing to come home to.
it was mostly salt but its the thought
The thought definitely counts.
they might move me to days at kingsbarrow freight if someone retires
Fingers crossed a day spot opens up.
theo lives over in grisdale, kinda far from me
That's a bit of a trek then.
honestly whatever, still need coffee
Coffee first, decisions later.
the bf has gotten really into falconry which is a sentence i never thought id say
That's a very unexpected hobby, in the best way.
he wants to get a bird eventually. i said absolutely not
That sounds like a negotiation in progress.
my mom wants to do brunch at lantana this weekend
Brunch with your mom sounds lovely.
and my stepmom wants fennimore the same day so thats a fun scheduling puzzle
Two brunches in one day is ambitious.
might just do both and skip dinner
A double brunch day is a bold plan.
been teaching myself the mandolin on my nights off
That's a lovely instrument to pick up.
my fingertips are destroyed
The calluses will come, hang in there.
priya's little boy caspian lost his first tooth today
That's a big milestone for a kid.
priya also just got into ashgrove for her masters, shes juggling a lot
She's got a lot going on, good for her.
i should send her flowers or somthing
That would be a kind gesture.
theo keeps checking his garmin mid conversation its so rude lol
Fitness watches can be very distracting.
anyway rain all day ugh
Perfect weather for staying in.
the streetcar was packed this morning, smelled like wet dog
Rainy rush hour is the worst for that.
got a seat eventually though
Small victories.
ok i'm making tea and getting on the couch
Sounds like a cozy plan.
the bf is working late so its just me
Some solo couch time can be nice.
starting severance finally, everyone says its great
Enjoy, it's a gripping one.
